about: #129: the lost ducks: with a duck of her flock in the hands, a wave points at the pen and the pen glows. At 21:00.
allow: is under the bottom of the screen

walk.thingExpr: (() => { const s = tre.activeVillage.state(); const h = s.entities.find((e) => e.id === 'hero').position; const d = s.entities.filter((e) => e.item?.kind === 'duck' && !e.item.stray && /-lost-/.test(e.item.zone ?? '') && !e.item.held).sort((a, b) => Math.hypot(a.position.x - h.x, a.position.z - h.z) - Math.hypot(b.position.x - h.x, b.position.z - h.z)); return d[0]?.id ?? null; })()
